final_assessment: Captured D-rc04-12, the definition of a readiness record, and amended D-rc04-3 with Sal's correction to it. The definition: a dated, AI-authored assertion at the end of a cadence that the work is ready to move forward, citing the independent passes it was formed against and naming what was accepted unresolved and why. Four properties, exactly ONE machine-checkable, and that asymmetry is the design — the engine never judges whether the AI was right to be ready, it refuses a claim the AI could not have formed, one predating the evidence it names. Framed as the D5 emit-composition architecture one seam later: engine owns the spine, the AI supplies the judgement, prose with a checkable spine. Worked against rc02c's six warnings entries, which sort into it cleanly, and the two that do NOT sort — a touchpoint divergence and an at-archive correction — turn out to be process notes that were in `warnings` only because `warnings` is where everything goes when nothing has a home. That is the argument for the stage in miniature. The amendment to D-rc04-3 matters more than a nuance. The original said findings requiring expansion get kicked back to architecture and THE AI MAKES THAT CALL. Sal corrected both halves: routing is the DEFAULT rather than the rule, since absorbing an expansion is sometimes the better call; and the AI does not make the call — it makes the CLASSIFICATION and the RECOMMENDATION, and the DECISION is Sal's. That three-part division is narrower than 'the AI decides' while still satisfying D-rc04-5, because the user steers rather than adjudicating, the AI having already named the fork and taken a position. Recorded as OBSERVED rather than aspirational: rc02c's cycle ran this shape four times without it being written down — the rc10 charter defect routed to architecture, the declaration hoist absorbed here, the instrument fix separated into its own commit, and the scoped external pass bought over a passed gate. Four forks, four recommendations, four Sal decisions, zero cases of the AI deciding alone and zero of Sal adjudicating unaided. The definition also exposes what it does not settle: a record's direction is the AI's own belief, but an expansion disposition is ratified rather than autonomous, so the record must say which.
